sql: SELECT "SportsInfo"."StuID" AS k, (CAST("SportsInfo"."GamesPlayed" AS REAL) / "SportsInfo"."HoursPerWeek") AS m1 FROM "SportsInfo" WHERE (CAST("SportsInfo"."GamesPlayed" AS REAL) / "SportsInfo"."HoursPerWeek") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: SportsInfo.sport games played per weekly hours spent on sport
why: sport games played / weekly hours spent on sport: the catalogue declares sport games played a rate over weekly hours spent on sport
rank SportsInfo rows by sport games played per weekly hours spent on sport
